about.title: Built for busy families
body: CarePlus was started by two pediatricians who were tired of 10-minute rushed visits and wanted to build a clinic where kids weren't scared and parents didn't feel dismissed.
Today we see the whole family — from newborn checkups through adult primary care — with same-week appointments and doctors who actually remember your name.

faqs.answer: Yes, telehealth is available for follow-ups and non-urgent consultations.

blogPosts.title: Your Baby's First-Year Immunization Schedule, Explained Simply
blogPosts.excerpt: A plain-language walkthrough of what shots happen when, and why the schedule is built the way it is.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Meenal Shah
content: The first-year immunization schedule can look overwhelming on paper, but it's built around one simple principle: protecting your baby right when they're most vulnerable to each specific disease.
Most vaccines are given in a series, not a single dose, because the immune response builds over multiple exposures — spacing isn't arbitrary.
It's normal for your baby to be fussy or have a mild fever for a day after certain vaccines; this is the immune system doing exactly what it's supposed to do.
If you're ever unsure about a specific vaccine, ask at the visit — we'd rather spend five extra minutes explaining than have you leave with questions.
